actions.details: Lowercases text, strips Latin diacritics, converts separators to hyphens, and preserves readable words for dot, plus, ampersand, and at signs.
actions.exampleOutput: cafe-plus-apis-and-sdks
actions.name: Slugify
actions.privacySummary: Runs locally in ActionClip’s JavaScript sandbox. Selected text does not leave your Mac.
actions.requirements: No setup required.
actions.summary: Turn selected text into a readable URL slug.
actions.template:
function run(selected_text) {
  return selected_text
    .normalize("NFKD")
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/\./g, "-dot-")
    .replace(/\+/g, "-plus-")
    .replace(/&/g, "-and-")
    .replace(/@/g, "-at-")
    .replace(/_/g, "-")
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s-]+/g, "")
    .replace(/[\s-]+/g, "-")
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "");
}

actions.details: Matches RewriteBar's generic PopClip integration: ActionClip copies the selection to the general clipboard, then opens rewritebar://command-menu so RewriteBar can read it.
actions.exampleOutput: RewriteBar opens its command menu with the selection on the clipboard.
actions.name: RewriteBar
actions.privacySummary: ActionClip places the selected text on the local clipboard and passes control to RewriteBar. RewriteBar's configured provider determines whether the text is processed locally or online.
actions.requirements: RewriteBar must be installed. This integration intentionally replaces the current clipboard contents.
actions.summary: Open RewriteBar's command menu for the selected text.
actions.template: rewritebar_command_menu

actions.details: Uses an allowlisted bundle-ID-to-shortcut table for Preview, Skim, Evernote, PDF Expert, Obsidian, GoodLinks, Scrivener, Pages, Logseq, DEVONthink, Alternote, iA Writer, iA Presenter, PDFpen, and Apple Notes. Unsupported apps fail without sending a shortcut.
actions.exampleOutput: ActionClip sends Preview's Control-Command-H highlight shortcut.
actions.name: Highlight
actions.privacySummary: ActionClip sends a reviewed keyboard shortcut to the active supported app. The selected text does not leave your Mac.
actions.requirements: The selection must remain active in one of the supported apps. Accessibility permission is required to target the source app.
actions.summary: Apply the active app's known highlight command.
actions.template: highlight_selection
